description: Source code for FreeType glyph rasterizer interface implementation, including functions for initializing, setting mode, transforming, getting control box, and rendering glyphs in monochrome mode.

methods.name: ft_raster1_init
methods.description: Initializes the raster renderer, resets its raster component.

methods.name: ft_raster1_set_mode
methods.description: Sets render-specific mode by passing mode tag and data to raster.

methods.name: ft_raster1_transform
methods.description: Transforms a glyph's outline with a matrix and translation delta.

methods.name: ft_raster1_get_cbox
methods.description: Retrieves the control box (bounding box) of a glyph.

methods.name: ft_raster1_render
methods.description: Converts a glyph outline into a monochrome bitmap.
